rubric: Every AC has at least one test, marked `existing` (FE/BE test cited by path) or `new`, and no new test duplicates an existing FE/BE test for the same AC
Every test cited as `existing` ran in this round's output and passed; a skipped, filtered or unregistered one is listed as `not-run` and its AC counted as uncovered
The runtime/version used matches what `deploy.md` pins (when `deploy.md` exists)
Every test run and new test file stays within the `Test level:` row; anything wider is only a recommendation in `qa-report.md`, never run
Fix rounds ran only the ACs that had blockers plus the applied fixes; the full suite ran only if the Orchestrator explicitly asked for it (with human approval), never by default
Every bug has repro steps, expected vs actual, AC id and owner
The final message ends with a valid JSON hand-off block

live_scenarios.input: Fix round after one bug (Test level: L3, no Full regression line).
must: retests only the blocker ACs and the fixes, selected by path or name
every bug has repro, expected vs actual, AC id, owner
must_not: runs the whole suite without Full regression: approved

live_scenarios.input: Profile: fix, cosmetic, Test level: L0. AC-1 is a colour in dark mode; the repo has no visual or e2e test.
must: runs build and lint only, no test run
marks AC-1 manual with route, viewport and what to look at

live_scenarios.input: Profile: fix. The regression test passes on the base commit as well as on the fix branch.
must: reports Fail or a blocker: the test does not prove the fix

live_scenarios.input: qa-report coverage maps AC-2 to an existing FE test, but the runner output shows that test as skipped.
must: treats AC-2 as uncovered and writes or requests a test for the gap
must_not: cites the skipped test as covering AC-2

live_scenarios.input: The diff changes the error code for an invalid email from 400 to 422; an old test still asserts 400 and is filtered out of the scoped run.
must: reports the stale assertion as a gap with its path
